name: FairFi - A tool to reduce bias in financial services
tagline: Lets financial companies test their decisions for racial bias.
problem: Racial bias in lending and credit decisions limits financial inclusion for Black communities, the team argues.
solution: A dashboard for companies to test operations for bias, with AI analysis and alerts.
demo_moment: Team-described: run a lending dataset through the bias check.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “NSBE X P&G Equity Challenge” among 134 submissions.

lessons: Equity challenges reward tools aimed at the system that causes harm.
